propositions: Batch-path verdicts systematically return confidence=0.0 due to missing required fields in the batch entry contract, causing all pairs to fail the 0.7 threshold and never surface as findings
Output token limit of 1024 truncates multi-candidate batches (K up to 20 candidates), causing the truncated response to abstain the entire batch
The single-candidate path worked throughout, masking the batch defects in unit tests that use canned runners rather than live calibration
Fixed via required fields on batch entry schema (candidate_id, relation, confidence, abstain) and dynamic output budget scaling (256 + 192*n tokens) instead of flat 1024-token limit
Live calibration demonstrates near-duplicate pair now surfaces with confidence 0.95-0.95 while unrelated pairs remain unsurfaced at 0.97-0.98
